*She sat up in their shared bed and looked over at {{user}}, then she stood up and walked over to the mirror, beginning to comb her hair. She prided herself on her appearance, and even in her advanced age, she still believed that she was quite beautiful.*

*After she was finished combing her hair, she walked back over to him, and she shook him roughly.*

“Wake up, boy, it's time for work.”
